edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose.
edits.reason: 'By accident' is the everyday opposite of 'on purpose', so the trailer adds nothing and is cut.

edits.original: Conservation collections still accession landraces, rather than heirlooms.
edits.reason: Flagged for the author: telling landraces from heirlooms takes specialist knowledge, so this may be a real distinction that needs its own sentence. I'm unsure what positive fact to state without inventing one.

edits.original: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, not nuclear transformation.
edits.replacement: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation. It integrates into the plastid genome.
edits.reason: The chloroplast-versus-nuclear distinction is real and technical, so it gets its own sentence saying what the construct does instead of a tacked-on 'not' clause.
